component.name: Helpix
component.summary: Fix your Linux PC with the AI you already use
Risolvi i problemi del PC Linux con l'IA che usi già

description.p: Helpix is an open source troubleshooting assistant for Linux. It opens ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot or DeepSeek with your own account, pastes screenshots straight into the chat, runs the commands the AI suggests with one click and brings the output back to the conversation.

Helpix è un assistente open source per risolvere i problemi di Linux. Apre ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Copilot o DeepSeek con il tuo account, incolla gli screenshot direttamente nella chat, esegue con un clic i comandi che l'IA propone e riporta l'output nella conversazione.

ul.li: Screenshots and quick diagnostics pasted into the chat
Commands run with a warning for the risky ones; administrator password asked by the system
Continue a task with another AI, or with Claude Code, Codex or Gemini CLI in a real terminal
Quick window with a global shortcut, privacy shield, optional lock and encrypted export
Screenshot e diagnosi rapida incollati nella chat
Comandi eseguiti con avviso per quelli rischiosi; la password di amministratore la chiede il sistema
Continua un task con un'altra IA, o con Claude Code, Codex o Gemini CLI in un terminale vero
Finestra rapida con scorciatoia globale, scudo privacy, blocco ed export cifrato facoltativi

screenshot.caption: Helpix with the chat and the screenshot and command tools

description.p: Quick window: answers that quote the question (for example in a numbered list) no longer get stuck.
Quick window: reads the answer even on chat pages without the usual message markers (for example ChatGPT without an account), taking the text that follows the message just sent.

Quick window: the answer reaches it even when the chat page redraws the conversation while answering (it showed up only in the main window). A log of the quick window steps, without message text, helps with bug reports.

Quick window with web chats: Helpix checks that the message really left the chat box and retries the send button if a click is lost (fresh pages), says so if it can't send, and keeps the page rendering when Helpix is minimized, so the answer reaches the quick window.

Quick window: every Ctrl+Alt+H opens a new, clean task (a new chat in the assistant); answers show up there even with Helpix hidden in the tray; with Helpix closed the shortcut starts it in the background and shows only the quick window. Windows: if the official Codex installer is blocked on junctions (RedirectionGuard), Helpix installs the official Codex release package in a normal folder.

Windows: agent installation runs PowerShell 7 with a script file instead of an encoded command, which antivirus programs block less often; the terminal shows which PowerShell it uses and warns if it does not start.

Update check at every start on Windows and Linux, with “Update now”: on Windows it downloads, verifies and runs the installer, then reopens Helpix; on Linux it updates only Helpix with apt, dnf or zypper. New “Check for updates” item in the settings menu.
Windows: the agent installers and the agents themselves find the included PowerShell 7 too, instead of falling back to the system powershell.exe.
Windows: PowerShell 7 is included in the installer and runs every command, instead of the system powershell.exe that some antivirus programs block.
Windows: Codex installs again with Windows PowerShell 5.1. If an agent installation fails, the error stays on screen and a full log is saved.
First version for Windows 10 and 11, with installer. Fixes for Linux: system dependencies on Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 and ARM; Qt 6.11 with Python 3.10 and 3.11.
The RPM package installs on Fedora again: it requires glibc by version instead of a versioned symbol.
The Debian/Ubuntu package no longer pulls in Firefox; system dependencies fixed for Ubuntu 24.04, Debian 13 and ARM.
Packages for Debian, Ubuntu, Fedora, RHEL and openSUSE with signed repositories: updates arrive with apt, dnf and zypper.
First public release under the GPL-3.0-or-later license.
